main_idea: On-policy distillation gives a net GDPval win-loss margin over the base model in two model families
ideas: On-policy distillation improves professional-work performance on GDPval
Nemotron student gains +20.9% net win-loss margin
Qwen student gains +21.4% net win-loss margin
Same recipe transfers across model families
Student learns from its own tokens, scored by teacher
Distilled model wins more paired comparisons than it loses
summary: The two margin cards and bar are a clear core, but a four-step pipeline, a second rubric metric, a win-rate arrow block, and several taglines and kickers clutter it; nothing essential is missing.
defects: AfterQuery logo mark is faint and low contrast on the cream background
Subtitle wraps leaving a one-word orphan line ('GDPval.')
